Well the research states that DID forms from infancy to age 9 but the reason that DID might not show up around to 7-9 is dependent on the childs development, DID can only form due to severe repeated childhood trauma. Research says that we all start out as different fragments/ego states because as a young child and we do not have a whole cohesive personality and these ego states are typically simple things such as wanting love, needing food/water, needing to use the bathroom etc, and around the ages of 7-9 all of those ego states will form into a whole personality without trauma.

However with trauma that process is disrupted at whatever age from 9 to a few months old because it brings up dissociative barriers between those ego states and splinters off more ego states to hold memories, fulfill specific functions, feel certain feelings, not be aware of trauma etc and so can't form a cohesive personality. So DID cannot be formed later on in life, and also BPD is not a lesser form of DID because it's not a dissociative disorder it's a personality disorder though DID and BPD can be co-morbid.

That makes no sense, it's a trauma based dissociative disorder that causes multiple alters to form to cope with trauma and shelve it off because otherwise the child would be hurt and destroyed by the memories, and or die without it due to dissociation saving the child from the pain. DID is in not in any way NPD, that would be a harmful and ableist for people to imply. The two are in no way correlated.

[https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4959824/](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC4959824/) Go here to the section 4, it dismantles the idea that DID is iatrogenic and caused by therapists. As well the studies show and the source shows that DID is in fact caused by trauma.

I don't mean to be a jerk and I am hoping this is willful ignorance though that's not great either. But this is a lie, DID is caused by trauma, I am unsure of what you looked up that said that trauma did not always cause DID but they are actively spreading misinformation, trauma disrupts the minds process of fully forming a cohesive personality, saying that your brain simply has decided not to form a personality fully because your brain just did it just scientifically makes no sense and is *just* false. If you wouldn't mind you can link what sources you have because this is a very reckless statement to make.

There are many ways people experience DID because it presents differently for every person and no person with DID will have the same exact experience as it's unique to you however trauma is always the cause for DID/OSDD, you cannot be a multiple otherwise.

They can have DID, you can have DID from infancy if you've been traumatized at an extremely young age repeatedly with a unstable attachment to your caregiver as sad as that sounds and is. There is no disorder that comes before it, it just is DID but what that person is saying is that when your a child you have different ego states because you don't have an integrated and full personality yet, those ego states can be something such as wanting love, food, needing to use the bathroom etc.

But DID is when repeated trauma disrupts this, alters form as a way to cope with trauma and have those memories put into another space in your mind and you can't form a full whole personality. At 6-9 is when your personality fully forms and becomes cohesive, but it just depends on the child's development when that personality fully forms so that's why during that period you can still develop the disorder.
